subject: biology

hotspots.label: Petal
hotspots.description: The colored, often scented leaves that surround the flower and attract pollinators.
hotspots.positionHint: A broad colored petal on the outer ring.
hotspots.function: Attracts pollinators with color and scent.

hotspots.label: Stamen
hotspots.description: The male part of the flower that makes pollen.
hotspots.positionHint: A slender stalk ringed around the center, holding an anther.
hotspots.function: The male part that makes pollen.

hotspots.label: Anther
hotspots.description: The tip of the stamen that makes and holds the pollen powder.
hotspots.positionHint: Small rounded tip on top of the stamen.

hotspots.label: Pistil
hotspots.description: The female part of the flower at the center that receives the pollen.
hotspots.positionHint: The upright central column in the middle of the flower.
hotspots.function: Receives pollen and is where the seed forms.

hotspots.label: Ovary (seed base)
hotspots.description: The base of the pistil that swells into a fruit holding seeds after fertilization.
hotspots.positionHint: The rounded base at the flower's center cut open.
hotspots.function: Grows into a fruit holding seeds.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean floral cross-section diorama - the flower is only softly muted color with restrained petals; strong saturated color reserved for the flat hotspot dots and the speculative pollen-dust.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. No emissive anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single flower cut in cross-section standing clear, showing an outer ring of colored petals, a ring of slender stamens with anthers, a central upright pistil, and an ovary well at the center. Small pollen-dust dots travel from anther to pistil in the animation layer. Restrained warm palette on cream paper. Named nodes: Petal, StamenRing, Anther, Pistil, OvaryBase, PollenDots. Budget 12-16k.
